# Owners Inc. (ownersinchq.com)

Owners Inc. is a family-owned business in Hastings, Minnesota. It runs a set of
online "finds" stores — one specialty store per category — where every product
shows its price, the retailer that sells it, and the date Owners Inc. checked
the price by hand at that retailer. Owners Inc. also offers bookkeeping
services for Hastings-area small businesses, done by phone and online.

Disclosure: Owners Inc. may earn a commission on purchases made through links
on its pages. It never changes the price a buyer pays.

Contact: hello@ownersinchq.com · (651) 314-9387 (call or text)

## Bookkeeping

- Bookkeeping services — first month free, then from $300/month; the exact
  monthly price is confirmed after the free month. Bookkeeping only (not tax
  filing or CPA work), by phone and online, no walk-in office:
  https://ownersinchq.com/bookkeeping-services/
